By the Court:-
1. Heard the parties.

2. This criminal miscellaneous petition has been filed invoking the jurisdiction of this Court under Section 482 Cr.P.C. with a prayer to quash the summoning order dated 06.09.2019 passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Dhanbad in C.P. Case No. 608 of 2019 by which the learned Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Dhanbad has found prima facie case for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 506 and Manish Kumar Saw @ Manish Kumar Shaw vs The State Of Jharkhand on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103389850/
1 379 of Indian Penal Code as also the entire criminal proceeding of C.P. Case No. 608 of 2019.

sentences.text: 3. The allegation against the petitioner is that the petitioner being the husband of the opposite party no.2 treated the complainant with cruelty by his willful conduct which is of such a nature to cause grievous injury, endanger to life and limb and health both mentally and physically of the complainant.

There is also allegation that the petitioner along with co-accused assaulted the complainant on several occasions and caused hurt to her and committed theft of her jewelry besides criminally intimating her.
4. On the basis of the materials available in the record, the learned Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Dhanbad found prima facie case and passed summoning order as already indicated above.
5. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the allegations against the petitioner are all false and the court has wrongly summoned the petitioner.

It is next submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner out of the wedlock with the complainant has one daughter and a son and only to harass the petitioner, this false case has been foisted.

Hence, it is submitted that the summoning order dated 06.09.2019 passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Dhanbad in C.P. Case No. 608 of 2019 as also the entire criminal proceeding of C.P. Case No.
608 of 2019 be quashed and set aside.

6. Learned Special Public Prosecutor and the learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 on the other hand opposes the prayer for quashing the summoning order dated 06.09.2019 passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Dhanbad in C.P. Case No. 608 of 2019 as also the entire criminal proceeding of C.P. Case No. 608 of 2019.

It is submitted by the learned Spl. P.P. and the learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 that the complainant in her complaint, statement on solemn affirmation and the inquiry witnesses have stated vividly about the cruelty perpetrated by the petitioner upon the opposite party no.2-complainant and having voluntarily caused hurt,
criminally intimated her and committed theft of jewelry of the complainant; which are sufficient to constitute the offences punishable, for which the learned Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Dhanbad has found prima facie case.
Hence, it is submitted that there being no merit in this criminal miscellaneous petition, the same be dismissed.

7. Having heard the submissions made at the Bar and after going through the materials in the record, it is pertinent to mention here that as already indicated above, the complaint of the complainant, the statement of the complainant on solemn affirmation and the statement of the inquiry witnesses are sufficient to constitute each of the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 506, 379 of Indian Penal Code; as there is direct and specific allegation against the petitioner that the petitioner being the husband of the opposite party no.2-complainant, treated the Manish Kumar Saw @ Manish Kumar Shaw vs The State Of Jharkhand on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103389850/
2 complainant with cruelty by indulging in willful act of such a nature that caused grievous injury and danger to life and limb of the complainant as well as which is danger to the mental and physical health of the complainant.

entities.text: Manish Kumar Saw @ Manish Kumar Shaw vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: There is also allegation of assault and voluntarily causing hurt to the complainant on several occasions and there is further allegation of criminal intimidation and commission of theft of jewelry of the complainant.

8. Under such circumstances, this Court is of the considered view that there is no justifiable reason to interfere with the summoning order dated 06.09.2019 passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Dhanbad in C.P. Case No. 608 of 2019 as also to quash the entire criminal proceeding of C.P. Case No. 608 of 2019.
9 . Accordingly, this criminal miscellaneous petition being without any merit is dismissed.

(Anil Kumar Choudhary, J.) High Court of Jharkhand, Ranchi Dated the 15th March, 2024 AFR/Sonu-Gunjan/-
